create_patterns.name: selection-no-load-when-two-objects-named.md
create_patterns.content:
# Nothing loaded for two-object tasks

Traces: t1 (two books to couch), t5 (two newspapers to drawer), t8 (two pencils to bedside table). Ground truth: pick_two_obj_and_place. Nothing was loaded in any of them.

Cue: the task says 'two' or gives a count. Load pick_two_obj_and_place, not pick_and_place.

create_patterns.name: selection-no-load-when-clean-implied.md
create_patterns.content:
# Nothing loaded when cleanliness is only implied

Traces: t3 (cleaned soap), t4 (clean fork), t6 (wet napkin), t7 (clean knife). Ground truth: pick_clean_then_place. Nothing was loaded in any of them.

Cue: words like clean, cleaned or wet mean a cleaning step comes before placing. Load pick_clean_then_place. 'Wet' is a weaker cue than 'clean', so check it against the other skills offered.

create_patterns.name: selection-no-load-for-plain-move.md
create_patterns.content:
# Nothing loaded for a plain single-object move

Trace: t2 (move keys from desk to safe). Ground truth: pick_and_place. Nothing was loaded.

Cue: one object, no heat, clean, cool or count words. Load the basic pick_and_place skill. It is also the default when no modifier word appears.
